描述_EN: cizhou wares were utilitarian at their time of production and were made in relatively large numbers. this vase is made in a shape known as meiping (prunus vase), although it was most likely used to store alcohol. this vase is an example of cizhou ware, a type of ceramic made in the northern part of china during the jin dynasty (1115-1234). the term cizhou encapsulates a range of wares made in several regions of northern china, often consisting of a course stoneware body covered with a white slip (a thin layer of wet clay), and then decorated with a bold design in a contrasting colour.
描述_ZN: 慈溪器皿在生产时是功利性的，而且制作数量相对较多。 这个花瓶的形状被称为梅花瓶，尽管它很可能是用来储存酒精的。 这个花瓶是Cizhou ware的一个例子，Cizhou ware是中国北方地区在金朝（1115-1234）时期制造的一种陶瓷类型。 这个术语囊括了中国北方几个地区的一系列器物，通常由白色滑液（一层薄薄的湿粘土）覆盖的石器主体组成，然后用对比色的大胆设计进行装饰。
